description: Complete reference patterns for all BitSec project types

payment.name: ERC20 Payment via msg.sender
invariants: fromAddress is always msg.sender
No parameter can override who pays
payment.code: function pay(address token, uint256 amount) external { IERC20(token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, wallet, amount); }
payment.vulnerability_if_missing: If fromAddress is a parameter, attacker can drain any user who approved the contract

rental.name: Rental Payment Authorization
invariants: Only token owner can list for sale/rent
Payment must go to the correct recipient
Rental duration must be validated
Deposit must be returned on valid cancellation
rental.vulnerability_if_missing: If payment authorization is missing, attacker can steal rental payments

rental.name: Rental State Consistency
invariants: Rental status must be updated atomically
Cannot rent an already rented token
Cannot cancel an already completed rental
Rental dates must not overlap
rental.vulnerability_if_missing: If state is not consistent, double-rental or fund loss can occur

rental.name: Rental Approval Cleanup
invariants: When rental ends, approvals must be revoked
When bid is cancelled, approvals must be revoked
When listing is removed, approvals must be revoked
rental.vulnerability_if_missing: If approvals are not cleaned up, attacker can use stale approvals to steal tokens

rental.name: Rental Price Validation
invariants: Price must be > 0
Price denomination must match expected token
Price cannot be changed during active listing
Deposit must cover potential damages
rental.vulnerability_if_missing: If price is not validated, attacker can manipulate prices or use wrong denomination

rental.name: Rental Duration Validation
invariants: Start date must be in the future
End date must be after start date
Duration must be within allowed limits
Extension must not exceed maximum
rental.vulnerability_if_missing: If duration is not validated, attacker can create invalid rentals

staking.name: Staking Delegation Invariant
invariants: Total delegated must equal sum of individual delegations
Undelegation must reduce delegation atomically
Rewards must be proportional to stake
Operator fee must be calculated correctly
staking.vulnerability_if_missing: If delegation invariant is broken, protocol can become insolvent

staking.name: Staking Reward Calculation
invariants: Rewards must be calculated on correct base amount
Fee must be deducted before distribution
Reward rate must be consistent across operators
No double-claiming of rewards
staking.vulnerability_if_missing: If reward calculation is wrong, users can earn incorrect rewards

staking.name: Staking Operator Fee
invariants: Operator fee must be within allowed bounds
Fee must be calculated on correct amount
Fee must be transferred to correct address
Fee cannot be changed without notice
staking.vulnerability_if_missing: If operator fee is wrong, operators can extract excess value

staking.name: Staking Undelegation Process
invariants: Undelegation must have a cooldown period
Undelegated tokens must be returned after cooldown
Partial undelegation must maintain minimum stake
Emergency undelegation must have penalty
staking.vulnerability_if_missing: If undelegation is not proper, users can rug pull or bypass cooldowns

defi.name: Flash Loan Reentrancy Protection
invariants: Flash loan must be repaid in same transaction
State must not be manipulable during flash loan
Oracle prices must be resilient to flash loans
defi.vulnerability_if_missing: If flash loan is not guarded, attacker can manipulate state in single transaction

defi.name: Slippage Protection
invariants: User must specify minimum output amount
Actual output must meet minimum
Deadline must be enforced
defi.vulnerability_if_missing: If slippage protection is missing, MEV bots can front-run and steal value

defi.name: Oracle Price Feed Integration
invariants: Price must be fresh (not stale)
Price must be from trusted oracle
Price manipulation must be mitigated
defi.vulnerability_if_missing: If price is stale or manipulable, attacker can exploit pricing errors

defi.name: Liquidity Invariant
invariants: Total liquidity must equal sum of all deposits
Withdrawals cannot exceed available liquidity
Pool ratios must be maintained
defi.vulnerability_if_missing: If liquidity invariant is broken, protocol can be drained

governance.name: Voting Power Calculation
invariants: Voting power must be based on actual stake
Voting power cannot be double-counted
Delegation must not increase total voting power
Snapshots must be taken at correct block
governance.vulnerability_if_missing: If voting power is wrong, attacker can manipulate governance

governance.name: Proposal Validation
invariants: Proposal threshold must be met
Voting period must be valid
Quorum must be reached for execution
Proposal cannot be modified after creation
governance.vulnerability_if_missing: If proposal is not validated, attacker can create malicious proposals

governance.name: Execution Safety
invariants: Execution must only happen after voting ends
Execution must only happen if proposal passed
Execution must be atomic
Timelock must be enforced
governance.vulnerability_if_missing: If execution is not safe, attacker can execute malicious proposals

dex.name: Constant Product Invariant
invariants: x * y = k must hold after each swap
Swap must not violate constant product
Fees must be correctly deducted
dex.vulnerability_if_missing: If constant product is violated, attacker can extract value from pool

dex.name: Liquidity Add/Remove
invariants: LP tokens must be proportional to liquidity added
Removal must return correct token amounts
First liquidity provider must set initial price
dex.vulnerability_if_missing: If liquidity operations are wrong, LPs can lose funds

dex.name: Price Oracle
invariants: TWAP must be calculated correctly
Price must not be manipulable in single block
Oracle updates must be permissionless
dex.vulnerability_if_missing: If price oracle is wrong, dependent protocols can be exploited

dex.name: Cross-Contract Swap
invariants: Multi-hop swaps must maintain slippage protection
Intermediate tokens must not be stuck
Failed swaps must revert all changes
dex.vulnerability_if_missing: If cross-contract swap is not atomic, attacker can extract intermediate tokens

access-control.name: Ownable Access Control
invariants: Only owner can call critical functions
Owner can be transferred (two-step preferred)
access-control.vulnerability_if_missing: If onlyOwner is missing, anyone can call critical functions

access-control.name: Admin Role Separation
invariants: Admin role is separate from operational roles
No role escalation
access-control.vulnerability_if_missing: If roles are not enforced, unauthorized users can execute privileged actions

nft.name: NFT Approval Restriction
invariants: Only authorized contracts can transfer NFTs
Approval is per-token, not global
nft.vulnerability_if_missing: If approval is not restricted, unauthorized users can transfer NFTs
